items.text: Signed candidate authentication and compatibility refuse tampering, stale predecessor, wrong target, expiry and unsafe database formats; output cannot authorize process mutation. Probe: owning ark contract tests.

Between elected-release verification and ark activation: acting node verifies notarized delegates-compute signed author, issuer, recipient, scope, validity and revocation; probe malicious grant and unauthorized author refusals with unchanged incumbent PID.

Between signed candidate content and full grant authority: authenticate exact Commitment Create ActionHash, EntryHash and independently pinned author using signed Holochain record. Probe: independent signature and record substitution refusal tests. No activation authority.

Between authenticated grant record and process stop: bind provider, recipient, candidate target scope and validity; obtain authenticated fresh grant status under an explicit stop-boundary rule. Refuse missing, stale, revoked or unavailable evidence with unchanged incumbent PID. DHT link absence is not fresh non-revocation.
1. Establish the activation contract and its refusal tests
2. Implement durable staging and a targeted ark transition
3. Prove readiness failure causes local rollback
4. Rejoin the shared evidence path after service returns
5. Rehearse the complete household ceremony twice
